name: sinav-gonderme-platformu
description: Modern exam and assignment management platform for Alanya Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi
author: PolyOS Team <1tune-going@icloud.com>
notes:
## Atolye Platform v4.4.4 Beta 3
SQLite yedekleme ve masaüstü güncelleme altyapısı. macOS paketleri geçici olarak askıya alınmıştır.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "node scripts/multi-port-bridge.js 80 5173"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.preview:full: concurrently "npm run preview" "npm run dev:backend" "node scripts/multi-port-bridge.js 80 4173"
scripts.package:client: cd client-electron && npm run build:linux-dir && cd .. && node scripts/package-client-deb.js
scripts.package:client-win: cd client-electron && npx electron-builder --win nsis && cd ..
scripts.package:client-all: npm run package:client && npm run package:client-win
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install
